name: Charge crystal
blurb: Violet, faintly warm. Could bridge a cracked cell.

name: Lift tooth
blurb: A hardened tooth off a lift rack. With a grip, it's a pick.

name: Spare grip
blurb: A worn shovel grip from the locker.

name: Fasteners
blurb: Bolts, washers, a few rivets.

name: Pipe length
blurb: Bulky. Good for ladder rails or a tank.

name: Wire
blurb: Copper, mostly unkinked.

name: Lamp cell
blurb: Holds a charge for a long while.

name: Seed tin
blurb: Old seeds. Some might still wake up.

name: Cracked pressure gauge
blurb: Cracked glass, working needle. A pump needs one.

name: Battery cell
blurb: Heavy. Enough to wake a battery bank.

name: Greens
blurb: Fresh. Grown at home.

name: Trail meal
blurb: Restores Max's strength on a long dig.

name: Lantern
blurb: Set it down anywhere and it keeps burning. Light the way home.

name: Ladder section
blurb: Place under an opening to climb it.

name: Water tank
blurb: Place it in the workshop to store water.

name: Pressure valve
blurb: Brass, heavy, threaded both ends. A pump won't hold pressure without one.

name: Rope
blurb: Old climbing line. Two lengths and an anchor will get you up a chimney.

name: Tinned ration
blurb: Beans, mostly. Eat one at the pantry to get your strength back.

name: Copper ore
blurb: Green-streaked rock. Smelted down, it’s wire.

name: Iron ore
blurb: Heavy and rust-red. Good for tools and fittings.

name: Quartz
blurb: Clear as ice. Lenses, lamps, maybe a radio.

name: Old coin
blurb: Money from before. Worth nothing, except to someone who misses it.

name: Faded photo
blurb: A family at a beach, squinting into a sun nobody here has seen.

name: Tin toy
blurb: A wind-up bird. It still hops, a little.

name: Glowcap spores
blurb: A pinch of dust that glows faintly. They grow in the dark.

name: Camp crate
blurb: Pitch it somewhere flat to make a camp: a crate to stash things in, far from home.

name: Glowcap
blurb: A pale mushroom with a faint glow. Two of them, cooked, make a meal.

name: Field workbench
blurb: Set it up anywhere and build there, not just at home.

name: Cot
blurb: A place to lie down and get your strength back, wherever you set it.

name: Wooden ladder
blurb: Lean it against any ledge and it stays there: a way up and back down.

name: Root torch
blurb: Bundled root fibre soaked in resin. Set it down for a warm light that keeps burning.

name: Duct tape
blurb: Silver and sticky. Holds most things together, for a while.

name: Bunk strap
blurb: A canvas strap off a broken bunk, with a steel buckle. Cinches tight.

name: Rubber gasket
blurb: A ring of rubber from an old washstand. Still soft.

name: Hose clamp
blurb: A proper steel clamp. It seals a fitting on its own.

name: Sealed water can
blurb: Builders’ stock, still sealed. Six clean cups. Another outing’s worth.

name: Filter assembly
blurb: A whole replacement filter, housing and all. Heavy. It could make the intake run clean.

name: Dad’s sketch
blurb: Dad’s pencil: a forked pipe, three white stripes, and a question mark where a second way in might be.

name: Crew roster
blurb: The builders’ crew list. Halfway down, in pencil, Dad’s name in his own hand.

name: Full water can
blurb: Mara's can, full to the cap. Heavy enough to feel in your shoulders.

name: Grow trays
blurb: A stack of shallow trays with drainage holes.

name: Inspection lamp
blurb: A hotel maintenance lamp on a hook. Bright, steady, and it still holds a charge.

name: Hotel battery
blurb: The hotel's emergency battery. Heavy, valuable, and somebody else wants it too.

name: Soccer ball
blurb: Scuffed, patched, still round. Somebody kept it pumped for years.

name: Breakfast card
blurb: “Hang on your door by 2 a.m.” Eggs, toast, juice, coffee. People ticked boxes for this.

name: Seed packets
blurb: Paper packets with pictures of what's inside. Some of the pictures are things nobody here has seen.

name: Cart wheels
blurb: Four small wheels off a housekeeping cart, still on their brackets.

name: Pressure regulator
blurb: A brass regulator from above. The lower pumps have been running without one for years.

name: Ellis’s lamp
blurb: Ellis lent it for the game. It goes back to him.
